rv.q: ERNEST SHACKLETON LOVES ME has a truly original concept, even if the plotting doesn't always match the originality of said concept (the ending, in particular, is too tidy).
I'm already calling for ERNEST SHACKLETON Loves Me to be extended. It's 90 minutes of pure entertainment, an adventure you don't want to miss!
In the sparkling, quirky, funny, and oddly beautiful musical Ernest Shackleton Loves Me, Joe DiPietro conjures a strange 90-minute trip into an idiosyncratic Twilight Zone.
"Ernest Shackleton Loves Me" is an efficient, ninety-minute adventure that will leave you believing that you, too, can surmount life's obstacles.
“Ernest Shackleton ” is a playful romp, pushing the envelope of musical stylings and overflowing with talent.
You will leave the theater with a tremendous smile on your face and a warm feeling in your heart.
